title: Lazar told officially he was 'radioactive'

tellings.quote: on an official level, they said, "You know, you're radioactive. We don't want to deal with you."

plain: After Bob Lazar went public with his claim that he had worked on recovered non-human craft for the US government, he says he was told at 'an official level' that he was radioactive, in the sense of untouchable. He tells Michels that the message was plain: 'You're radioactive. We don't want to deal with you.' He does not say on the show who exactly delivered it.
